Priya (AE): Got a SIG/CAIQ from Primex this morning. They want answers for Dedicated + Private deployment, data residency (EU-only), and KMS/HSM details. Need this back to the customer by Thu EOD. Attaching the questionnaire here: https://drive.redwood/primex-sig-2026.pdf @Derek can you pick this up or assign?

Aisha (Sales Ops): Created intake ticket SEC-2026 in Jira and uploaded the PDF to the ticket. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026
Ticket excerpt:
```
SEC-2026 Primex SIG intake
Submitted: 2026-03-27 09:12 UTC
Attachments: primex-sig-2026.pdf
Priority: P2 (customer deadline Thu EOD)
```

Derek (Security): I can take it. Quick Qs: 1) Are they evaluating Hosted API at all or strictly Private/Dedicated for the POC? 2) Do we have any contact for their infra/network person for diagrams and ACLs?

Priya (AE): Strictly Private/Dedicated for POC. Customer wants Redwood to run in their VPC with customer-managed KMS. Contact: marta@primex.com (Infra lead). They also asked about SOC 2 Type II evidence and encryption key rotation policy.

sec-reviewer-bot: :gear: Parsed questionnaire: 62 questions total. 39 auto-matched to canned answers, 23 require manual review. Missing docs flagged: network diagram, customer KMS flow, SOC2 report link.

Derek (Security): Thanks. I updated SEC-2026 and assigned to myself. ETA 48 hours for initial pass (answers + docs we can provide). I need: network diagram from Primex, confirmation on KMS (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed), expected retention window, and any compliance addenda.

Samir (PS): For the POC infra side, we'll need sample VPC peering steps and expected ports. Priya — can you share the POC network requirements doc? I'll draft a short runbook we can hand to Primex infra.

Priya (AE): Dropped the POC network reqs in the ticket comments (SEC-2026). Also shared Marta's calendar link for a sync: https://cal.pri/primex-marta

Aisha (Sales Ops): Update: ticket now has labels [sig, private-deploy, eu-residency]. Slack reminder set for Thu 15:00 UTC to confirm final answers with customer.

Derek (Security): Quick status update after initial review:
- Auto-resolved: 39 Qs
- Needs manual response: 23 Qs (main clusters: cryptographic key lifecycle, access control for KV caches, deployment isolation controls)
- Docs to attach: SOC2 Type II (redwood-soc2-2025.pdf), KMS integration guide (kms-integration-v2.md), Private deployment network checklist.

Derek (Security): Drafted proposed answers for the crypto section — dropping below, please review before I post to customer:
```
Q: Where are encryption keys stored?
A: Customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM. Redwood supports AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and external HSMs via customer key proxy. Keys never stored in plaintext on-host.

Q: Key rotation policy?
A: Redwood follows rotational best-practices; keys rotated per customer policy. We support automated rotation hooks for supported KMS vendors; rotation procedures are documented in the KMS integration guide.
```

Priya (AE): Looks good to me. FYI Primex requested contract language around KMS control — legal will surface a short addendum if needed.

Samir (PS): I'll attach the runbook and sample security group rules to SEC-2026 by EOD.

sec-reviewer-bot: :white_check_mark: SEC-2026 progress update: assigned -> Derek (Security). 23 items flagged -> 8 now drafted by Derek, 15 pending. Next reminder set in 24h.

Derek (Security): Final note for the thread — I'll publish the responses to the customer via the ticket (cc Priya) once we have the network diagram from Marta. If we don't receive it, I can send our standard 'needs-info' reply with the 8 answered items and a checklist requesting the rest.

Priya (AE): Thanks Derek — I'll ping Marta now. Team, please mark any other blockers in the Jira ticket so we can keep this single source of truth. :thumbsup:
